title: Hatsune Miku — Watching Over Those First Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What brings Mafuyu here today?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I'm glad she came to visit...
At the same time, I can't help but wonder if something's bothering her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, nothing's bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I finished doing my homework, but it was still before 25:00 so I decided to come to take a break here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mind if I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She seems a little tired...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (However, I'm not sensing any pain, which is good...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you mind just listening like this for a little while?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm...? No, I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Remember that story about what happened two years ago?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Initially, I couldn't actually recall much of what I was doing back then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I could remember that I was in junior high school, but not much else besides that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I tried thinking about whether that had to do with two years elapsing or if the “real me” was already gone, but couldn't come up with an answer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
However...
You were able to talk about school and Kanade's song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was only when Kanade started talking that I was able to recall when and where I heard her music for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As she progressed through that story, I began recalling the circumstances behind me actually discovering that one song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, I don't really remember what I was doing in school and such outside of all that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And yet, I was reminded of Kanade's song as well as my first inclination to make my own music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't say...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it may be because these events had a significant impact on you. That could be why you were able to remember...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe. I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu?
Have you felt or thought about anything else since then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Well, I've tried wondering what I would be like now if I hadn't met Kanade back then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, if I never came to this SEKAI or met you, Miku. Things like that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If none of those things had happened, I probably would've been gone by now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
An empty shell of what I used to be.
Unfeeling and hopelessly immobile...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I would've had nothing else to do except wait silently as my physical form rotted away...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But that's just a case of “what if?”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was able to meet Kanade, I started making my own music, and I even met Ena and Mizuki, as well as you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I'm really glad that I did...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Miku...
You mentioned before how this SEKAI won't disappear.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said this place would continue to exist even if I were to help give rise to a song after discovering my true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is that true even now...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thoughts, feelings and memories can all change or be forgotten...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they won't disappear entirely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why SEKAI will continue to exist.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I, as well as this SEKAI, will remember, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Forever and ever and ever...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
I should go back soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you for coming to visit, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: See you later, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome anytime, Mafuyu.
I'll always be right here, waiting...
